query:
SELECT pool_address
                  FROM pools
                 WHERE first_seen_at <= COALESCE($1, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
                   AND (first_seen_at < COALESCE($1, 'infinity'::TIMESTAMPTZ)
                        OR pool_address < $2)
                 ORDER BY first_seen_at DESC, pool_address DESC
                 LIMIT $3
